enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Action Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one named operation a caller can request, with its inputs, filed in an actions folder.

records.name: Adapter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that translates between the system's interface and an outside one, filed in an adapters folder.

records.name: Port Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares an interface the core needs from the outside, with no implementation, filed in a ports folder.

records.name: Boundary Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that marks where one module's responsibility ends and checks what crosses it, filed in a boundaries folder.

records.name: Interface Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares the operations a type offers without implementing them, filed in an interfaces folder.

records.name: Abstraction Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a general base others specialize, filed in an abstractions folder.

records.name: Facade Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that offers one simple entry to a group of more complex parts, filed in a facades folder.

records.name: Wrapper Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that encloses another object to change how it is called while keeping what it does, filed in a wrappers folder.

records.name: Decorator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that adds behavior to an object behind the object's own interface, filed in a decorators folder.

records.name: Delegate Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that receives work another object hands on instead of doing it itself, filed in a delegates folder.

records.name: Mixin Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies reusable members many types can include, filed in a mixins folder.

records.name: Trait Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares a named set of behaviors a type can implement, filed in a traits folder.

records.name: Composite Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that treats a tree of parts and a single part through one interface, filed in a composites folder.

records.name: Primitive Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a smallest building block higher parts are composed from, filed in a primitives folder.

records.name: Module Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares a self-contained unit with the surface it exports, filed in a modules folder.

records.name: Package Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a distributable unit and what it contains, filed in a packages folder.

records.name: Namespace Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that groups names under one prefix so they cannot collide with others, filed in a namespaces folder.

records.name: Layer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one tier of a layered structure and what it may depend on, filed in a layers folder.

records.name: Contract Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that states what one side of a boundary guarantees to the other, filed in a contracts folder.

records.name: Schemas Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that defines the shapes data must take, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Types Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that declares the types other code uses, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Enums Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that declares closed sets of named values, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Union Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a value that is exactly one of several declared shapes, filed in a unions folder.

records.name: Alias Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that gives a second name to an existing type or value, filed in an aliases folder.

records.name: Guard Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that narrows a value's type after proving what it is, filed in a guards folder.

records.name: Predicate Tag

distinctFrom.reason: A predicate answers yes or no, while a validator also reports why its input is not valid.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that answers yes or no about a value, filed in a predicates folder.

records.name: Identifier Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that creates or validates the identifiers records are addressed by, filed in an identifiers folder.

records.name: Metadata Tag

distinctFrom.reason: Metadata is the descriptive data, while the metadata tag names the file concern that holds it.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds data describing other data or code, filed in a metadata folder.

records.name: Annotation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines markers attached to code for tools to read, filed in an annotations folder.

records.name: Constants Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that declares named values fixed at build time, plural in both folder and tag, which also holds id tables.

records.name: Default Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies the values used where a caller sets none, filed in a defaults folder.

records.name: Extension Tag

distinctFrom.reason: An extension plugs into a host's declared extension point, while a plugin is discovered and loaded by the host.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that adds a capability to a host through the host's declared extension point, filed in an extensions folder.

records.name: Plugin Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that is discovered and loaded by a host to add behavior without editing the host, filed in a plugins folder.

records.name: Hook Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs when a host reaches one named point in its flow, filed in a hooks folder.

records.name: Manifest Tag

distinctFrom.reason: A manifest is the declarative document, while the manifest tag names the file concern that holds one.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares what a unit contains or provides for a loader to read, filed in a manifests folder.

records.name: Descriptor Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that describes one registrable thing in the shape its registry expects, filed in a descriptors folder.

records.name: Registrar Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that enters members into a registry, filed in a registrars folder.

records.name: Registry Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a named set of known members and answers lookups against it, filed in a registries folder.

records.name: Provider Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies an instance or a value on request, filed in a providers folder.

records.name: Factory Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that constructs instances so callers never call a constructor directly, filed in a factories folder.

records.name: Builder Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that assembles a complex object or a build output step by step, filed in a builders folder.

records.name: Injector Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies a component's dependencies from outside it, filed in an injectors folder.

records.name: Binding Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that ties an abstract name to the concrete value or implementation it resolves to, filed in a bindings folder.

records.name: Resolver Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that turns a reference into the thing it refers to, filed in a resolvers folder.

records.name: Locator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that finds where a service or a resource lives, filed in a locators folder.

records.name: Loader Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that reads a resource from storage or the network into memory, filed in a loaders folder.

records.name: Dependency-Management Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares and resolves the versions of the packages a unit depends on, filed in a dependency-management folder.

records.name: Compatibility Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides whether two versions or environments can work together, filed in a compatibility folder.

records.name: Compatibility-Layer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that presents an old interface on top of a new implementation, filed in a compatibility-layers folder.

records.name: Compatibility-Shim Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that patches one small difference between environments so shared code runs on both, filed in a compatibility-shims folder.

records.name: Polyfill Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies a platform feature where the running platform lacks it, filed in a polyfills folder.

records.name: Versioning Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that assigns, compares or migrates between versions, filed in a versioning folder.

records.name: Deprecation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that marks a surface as scheduled for removal and reports its uses, filed in a deprecations folder.

records.name: Cache Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that keeps computed or fetched values so a repeated request is answered without the original work, filed in a caches folder.

records.name: Cache-Key Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that derives the key a cached value is stored and found under, filed in a cache-keys folder.

records.name: Invalidation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides when a cached value no longer holds and removes it, filed in an invalidation folder.

records.name: Eviction Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that chooses which entries a full cache drops, filed in an eviction folder.

records.name: Expiration Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that ends an entry's life after a stated condition or time, filed in an expiration folder.

records.name: Memoization Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that remembers a function's results by its arguments, filed in a memoization folder.

records.name: Prefetching Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that loads what is likely to be needed before it is asked for, filed in a prefetching folder.

records.name: Pooling Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides how pooled resources are sized, lent and returned, filed in a pooling folder.

records.name: Batching Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that groups many small operations into fewer larger ones, filed in a batching folder.

records.name: Lazy-Loading Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defers loading a part until the first time it is used, filed in a lazy-loading folder.

records.name: Compression Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that encodes data into fewer bytes and restores it, filed in a compression folder.

records.name: Config Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the mass tag for a file that holds the settings a unit reads at start, singular in both folder and tag.

records.name: Setting Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one configurable option with its type and default, filed in a settings folder.

records.name: Profile Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that bundles a named set of settings chosen together, filed in a profiles folder.

records.name: Environment Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that reads and validates the values that differ between deployments, filed in an environments folder.

records.name: Preference Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a participant's own choices and how they persist, filed in a preferences folder.

records.name: Override Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that replaces a default setting for a stated scope, filed in an overrides folder.

records.name: Parameter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares the parameters an operation accepts with their bounds, filed in a parameters folder.

records.name: Precedence Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides which of several conflicting sources of a setting wins, filed in a precedence folder.

records.name: Flag Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a boolean switch read at run time, filed in a flags folder.

records.name: Feature-Flag Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that turns one feature on or off for a stated audience without a deploy, filed in a feature-flags folder.

records.name: Toggle Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that switches between two behaviors from a control a participant sets, filed in a toggles folder.

records.name: Kill-Switch Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that disables a capability immediately when it misbehaves, filed in a kill-switches folder.

records.name: Remote-Config Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that fetches settings from a service while the program runs, filed in a remote-config folder.

records.name: Persistence Tag

distinctFrom.reason: Persistence saves state so it survives the process, while a store holds state and controls how it is read and changed.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that saves state so it survives the process, filed in a persistence folder.

records.name: Storage Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that wraps a storage medium behind reads and writes of bytes or records, filed in a storage folder.

records.name: Repository Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that gives domain code a collection-like interface over stored records, filed in a repositories folder.

records.name: Migration Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that moves stored data or a schema from one version to the next, filed in a migrations folder.

records.name: Bus Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries messages between publishers and subscribers who never refer to each other, filed in a buses folder.

records.name: Topic Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a named stream of messages and its schema, filed in a topics folder.

records.name: Stream Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines an ordered, unbounded sequence of records processed as they arrive, filed in a streams folder.

records.name: Asset Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that locates and describes a static resource the product serves, filed in an assets folder.

records.name: Font Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares a typeface and how it loads, filed in a fonts folder.

records.name: Icons Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the collection tag for a file that declares the icons a product uses, plural in both folder and tag.

records.name: Endpoint Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one address a service answers and the request it accepts, filed in an endpoints folder.
